*Foothill Regional Medical Center Earns Multiple National Recognitions for Orthopedic Excellence and High-Quality Patient Outcomes*


ALHAMBRA, Calif.


, Nov. 10, 2026


/PRNewswire/ -- Foothill Regional Medical Center, part of Astrana Health, Inc. (NASDAQ: ASTH), earned multiple national honors from **Healthgrades** , the leading resource connecting consumers, physicians, and health systems. These prestigious awards highlight the hospital's continued commitment to delivering exceptional orthopedic care and achieving outstanding patient outcomes.


Among the most notable achievements, Foothill Regional Medical Center was named one of **Healthgrades America's 100 Best Hospitals for Orthopedic Surgery** and one of **Healthgrades America's 100 Best Hospitals for Joint Replacement** . The hospital also earned a **Five-Star Rating for Treatment of Diabetic Hospitalizations** .


These awards place Foothill Regional Medical Center among the top-performing hospitals in the nation for orthopedic care and reinforce its reputation for clinical excellence across multiple specialties.


"These recognitions reflect the dedication, expertise, and compassion of our physicians, nurses, clinical teams, and support staff," said Araceli Lonergan, CEO. "Being named among America's top hospitals for orthopedic surgery and joint replacement is a testament to our ongoing commitment to delivering high-quality, patient-centered care and achieving exceptional outcomes for the communities we serve."


The annual Healthgrades Specialty Excellence Awards evaluate hospital performance across numerous procedures and conditions, recognizing organizations that consistently achieve superior clinical outcomes. Foothill Regional Medical Center's continued success in orthopedic care reflects its focus on advanced treatment options, evidence-based practices, and a patient-first approach.


**About Foothill Regional Medical Center:**


Foothill Regional Medical Center is a general acute care hospital with 177 beds, including 42 pediatric subacute beds. Services include general and specialized surgery and robotics, an orthopedics and spine program, a nationally accredited weight-loss surgery program, a paramedic-receiving emergency department, and an expanded range of quality medical programs and services. The hospital is centrally located in Orange County. As of July 2025, Foothill Regional is part of Astrana Health. To learn more, visit[FoothillRegionalMedicalCenter.com](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4819523-1&h=2809738917&u=https%3A%2F%2Fc212.net%2Fc%2Flink%2F%3Ft%3D0%26l%3Den%26o%3D4388013-1%26h%3D2614739109%26u%3Dhttps%253A%252F%252Fwww.foothillregionalmedicalcenter.com%252F%26a%3DFoothillRegionalMedicalCenter.com&a=FoothillRegionalMedicalCenter.com) or call (714) 619-7700.


**About Astrana Health, Inc.**


Astrana Health is a physician-centric, AI-powered healthcare company committed to delivering high-quality, patient-centered care. Built from the physician's perspective, Astrana combines scalable care delivery infrastructure, a proprietary technology platform, and aligned provider networks to enable proactive, preventive care at scale, improving patient outcomes, enhancing patient experiences, supporting provider well-being, and driving greater value across the healthcare system.


Today, Astrana supports more than 20,000 providers and over 1.5 million patients in value-based care arrangements through its affiliated provider networks, management services organization, and integrated care delivery clinics spanning primary, specialty, and ancillary care. Together, Astrana is building the healthcare system we all deserve - one that delivers better care, better experiences, and better outcomes for all. For more information, visit[www.astranahealth.com](http://www.astranahealth.com/) .


**About Healthgrades**


Healthgrades is dedicated to empowering stronger and more meaningful connections between patients and their healthcare providers. As the #1 platform for finding a doctor and a leader in healthcare transparency, Healthgrades helps millions of consumers each month find and schedule appointments with their healthcare professional of choice and prepare for their appointments with best-in-class, treatment-focused content.
